Signature move

The hard-stop pull-up.

He attacks downhill at full speed so his defender has to backpedal, then slams on the brakes. The defender keeps drifting back, and Gilgeous-Alexander rises into the gap for the pull-up. The Ringer calls it “slamming his brakes to create an exaggerated window of separation.”

  1. Downhill. Full speed at the rim, so the defender backpedals.
  2. The brakes. One hard stop, lead foot out front. The defender keeps going.
  3. The pull-up. Up into the gap before he can close it.
